SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - AUGUST 19, 2020 -
07:00 P.M.
TELECONFERENCE MEETING AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20 VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID # 840 7301 8113
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, the City Council Chamber and City Hall are closed to the public. Consistent with State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the Los Angeles County Health Officer’s “Safer at Home Order for Control of COVID-19” the Cerritos Planning Commission will participate in the meeting through teleconference. Public participation in the meeting will be facilitated through the electronic methods as described below.
Agenda Materials:
The agenda and agenda packet related to items on this agenda are available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us. Materials submitted to the Cerritos Planning Commission after distribution of the agenda packet will be made available for public inspection by contacting the Department of Community Development at (562) 916-1201.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION:
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us and on Cerritos TV3.
Public Comments:
Pursuant to California State law, public comments are limited to the items listed on this special meeting agenda only. Members of the public may provide public comment through the following methods:
Email: Members of the public may provide public comment by submitting an email to planning@cerritos.us by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number for which you would like to provide comment in the subject line of the email. The public comment will be distributed to all members of the Planning Commission prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: You may provide audio public comment by connecting to the teleconference meeting online or by telephone/mobile call (please select only one method). Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time on the agenda. You must be available to provide comment at the time you are called upon to speak. If you are not planning on providing public comment we encourage you to observe the meeting via livestream or on Cerritos TV3 to allow staff to more effectively manage the number of teleconference connections.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84073018113
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 840 7301 8113
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations:
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

9A.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF PRECISE PLAN 2020-5, A PROPOSAL BY CLARKDALE ESTATE HOMES, LLC TO CONSTRUCT A NEW SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT COMPRISED OF FIVE (5) TWO-STORY RESIDENCES FEATURING ENHANCED ARCHITECTURAL DETAILING. IN CONJUNCTION WITH THIS PROJECT, ACLARE STREET WILL BE VACATED AND PERMANENTLY CLOSED TO ACCOMMODATE THE CONSTRUCTION OF A NEW 8'-0"-HIGH PERIMETER BLOCK WALL ALONG THE EAST PROPERTY LINE AND THE CONSTRUCTION OF ONE (1) OF THE FIVE (5) RESIDENCES OVER THE STREET. ADDITIONAL IMPROVEMENTS INCLUDE SIDEWALK, PARKWAY LANDSCAPE, AND RELATED SITE IMPROVEMENTS. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS LOCATED AT 17200 CLARKDALE AVENUE (APN 7033-004-039 AND APN 7033-004-046).*
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF TENTATIVE TRACT MAP 82918, A PROPOSAL BY CLARKDALE ESTATE HOMES, LLC, TO SUBDIVIDE AN EXISTING PROPERTY INTO A TRACT COMPRISED OF FIVE (5) SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL LOTS. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS LOCATED AT 17200 CLARKDALE AVENUE (APN 7033-004-039 AND APN 7033-004-046).*
*Pursuant to Section 15332 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

9C.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PERMIT 2007-4(2020) RENEWAL, A REQUEST BY APPLICANT CROWN CASTLE, ON BEHALF OF T-MOBILE WIRELESS, TO RENEW AN EXISTING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY ON AN INDUSTRIAL PROPERTY. THE EXISTING WIRELESS FACILITY CONTAINS THREE (3) EIGHT-FOOT PANEL ANTENNAS AND SIX (6) SIX-FOOT PANEL ANTENNAS MOUNTED ON THE MONOPINE STRUCTURE. AN EXISTING EQUIPMENT ENCLOSURE IS LOCATED BENEATH THE SUBJECT FACILITY THAT CONTAINS TWO (2) EQUIPMENT CABINETS, A GLOBAL POSITIONING ANTENNA AND OTHER SUPPORT EQUIPMENT FOR WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PURPOSES. THE APPLICANT WILL RE-BRANCH THE MONOPINE STRUCTURE AS PART OF THE RENEWAL REQUEST. THE SUBJECT MONOPINE WIRELESS FACILITY IS LOCATED AT 13041 166TH STREET, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 AND IS ZONED DEVELOPMENT AREA ONE (ADP-1) (APN 7005-006-076).*
